_note: A NOTAM's own card, the engine's notam_card (engine/crates/weather/src/notam_read/card.rs), read from its parts as FAA Order JO 7930.2 gives them: the keyword (1-2-1), a surface and its condition (3-3-5, 3-3-6; CLSD and NA, JO 7340.2), an FDC procedure NOTAM's titles (7-1-3), PERM (4-2-1), and a permanent one with an EST end or none running until the charts are updated. The first is the owner's FDC 6/3373 at KARR (2026-11-23); each answer is worked by hand from the NOTAM's words. engine/facade/tests/notam_read.rs asks the engine each case.

cases.about: A runway closed for good takes the field's RNAV departures away (SID, 7-1-3; PERMANENTLY CLSD; NA)

ELANR NINE DEPARTURE (RNAV)... OBENE THREE DEPARTURE (RNAV)... RWY 18/36 PROCEDURES NA. RWY 18/36 PERMANENTLY CLSD. 2605271843-2805271843EST

answer.title: Runway 18/36 closed
answer.effect: Runway 18/36 is permanently closed, so its RNAV departures are not authorized.

cases.about: A taxiway closed between two others names the closed one, never a between-point (3-3-6)
cases.text: !ORD 11/070 ORD TWY A BTN TWY B AND TWY C CLSD 2611120000-2611202359

answer.title: Taxiway A closed between taxiway B and taxiway C
answer.effect: Taxiway A is closed between taxiway B and taxiway C.

cases.about: A taxiway closed between a taxiway and a runway: the runway stays open (3-3-6)

answer.title: Taxiway A closed between taxiway B and runway 01/19
answer.effect: Taxiway A is closed between taxiway B and runway 01/19.
